rule: Sizes and limits the mock repeats. A change in Rust fails this file on both sides until the mock follows.

cases.name: feedDefaultPage
cases.what: entries in a feed page when the caller gives no limit

cases.name: feedMaxPage
cases.what: the largest feed or search page

cases.name: agentLogPage
cases.what: rows in a page of the agent call log

cases.name: trashDays
cases.what: days an entry stays in the trash

cases.name: appendWindowMs
cases.what: the longest age of an entry capture can append to

cases.name: chatIconBytes
cases.what: the longest chat emoji in bytes

cases.name: replyExcerptChars
cases.what: the length of a reply quote

cases.name: onThisDayDetailedYears
cases.what: years of the card shown with entries

cases.name: onThisDayEntriesPerYear
cases.what: entries shown per year on the card

cases.name: onThisDayPreviewChars
cases.what: the length of an entry preview on the card

cases.name: forestExcerptChars
cases.what: the length of the day excerpt in the forest

cases.name: attachmentsPerEntry
cases.what: attachments in one entry or draft

cases.name: pasteMaxBytes
cases.what: the largest pasted file or voice note
